title: game.status
description: Several games (MULTI_GAME_PLAN §4.7, MG2): one hidden game's story progress, built by observe/kb_progress.lua after the snapshot, after session.bound, on save.created and save.loaded, and when a marker or the badge count changes. The client forwards it to the server with its link's region; the server keeps one record per player and region and shows it on F7; the pass reads it to decide between resuming and starting the far game.

playthrough.description: title: no live game (the boot screens, the title, its menus); fresh: a New Game never saved; saved: loaded by CONTINUE or saved since.

ingame.description: True when the hidden game is in its overworld.

markers.description: The game profile's markers (protocol/games.json), each resolved by the adapter in its own flag namespace: starter, champion, ...

name.description: The save's player name (the player's own text; D6: the client enters it for a game it starts), absent at the title.

slot.description: The active save slot (0: the flat legacy save), as session.bound carries it.

visitors.description: FOREIGN_POKEMON_PLAN §4.1: how many party members this game shows as visitors (the HUD's line).

feature.description: The facility whose desk was refused.

n.description: How many refusals so far this start (a new one shows the HUD's note again).

refused.description: FOREIGN_POKEMON_PLAN §4.12, Q1 (FP5): the last facility desk the adapter refused while a client follows (its rules and rentals are FP9's), for the HUD's note.
